# Linear Algebra Experiments: Eigenvalues, PCA, and Visualization
**Author:** Lance Dalisay  
**Dataset:** `data/Student_Daily_Food_Expenses_Model_Ready.csv`  

This notebook explores the covariance structure, eigendecomposition, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) of the student daily food expense dataset.

import sys
import os
sys.path.append(os.path.abspath('..'))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from modules.eigen_pca import EigenPCA
from modules.visualization import Visualizer

df = pd.read_csv('../data/Student_Daily_Food_Expenses_Model_Ready.csv')
print('Dataset Shape:', df.shape)
display(df.head())

# Select numeric columns and separate target if present (assumed last column)
numeric_df = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).dropna()
X_df = numeric_df.iloc[:, :-1]
y = numeric_df.iloc[:, -1].values
feature_names = X_df.columns.tolist()

# Standardize (Z-score normalization) before PCA
X_scaled = (X_df.values - X_df.values.mean(axis=0)) / X_df.values.std(axis=0, ddof=1)

pca = EigenPCA(n_components=0.90)  # Retain enough PCs for 90% variance
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

summary_df, loadings_df = pca.get_summary_table(feature_names=feature_names)
print('--- Eigenvalues & Explained Variance ---')
display(summary_df)

print('--- Eigenvector Loadings ---')
display(loadings_df)
### 3. Verify Orthogonality of Eigenvectors ($V^T V = I$)

orthogonality_check = np.round(pca.eigenvectors.T @ pca.eigenvectors, 4)
print('V^T * V (Should be Identity Matrix):')
print(orthogonality_check)

viz = Visualizer(output_dir='../outputs/plots')

viz.plot_correlation_heatmap(numeric_df, show=True)
viz.plot_scree(pca.explained_variance_ratio, pca.cumulative_variance_ratio, show=True)

if X_pca.shape[1] >= 2:
    viz.plot_pca_2d(X_pca, target=y, target_name=numeric_df.columns[-1], show=True)
    viz.plot_biplot(X_pca, pca.eigenvectors, feature_names, show=True)
